**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13099893), [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/1561016164), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000074012), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/relationshipxx), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=250847) 
T-Team Leader… this is… I mean, what happened is… No, what I mean is—” As if it wasn’t bad enough that her flawless, perfect boss caught her with a sex toy in her hands… “B-because… this happened because of me, please let me take responsibility— no, please let me be the one to take responsibility…!” “…Are you serious?” She even slipped up and said something insane. Ever since that day, all Ji-yu can see flashing before her eyes is her boss’s… huge XX. She keeps avoiding him around the office, yet she can’t stop remembering what she saw. Unable to hold herself back any longer, Ji-yu finally blurts out: “C-can’t you just… show me one more time?” “…What?” “I know I’m being weird, I swear I know. But after that day… I just keep thinking about yours. I feel like if I see it just one more time, I’ll stop thinking about it… I-I’m really sorry, I’m just losing my mind!” She makes a ridiculous request, acting like she’s gone crazy. But instead of being disgusted, her boss steps closer— as if everything is going exactly as he planned.
